property_summary: For any caller who is the current ceoAddress, after calling DrugDealer() the contract's ceoAddress remains equal to the caller (i.e., CEO can re-set themselves to their own EOA); the mutant breaks this because it sets ceoAddress to address(this) instead of msg.sender.
change_summary: Keep require but flip assignment to set ceoAddress to address(this) (contract becomes its own CEO).
